passages.text: Our class rehearses a play about an emperor who rules an imaginary country. Sam wants to wear the paper crown and give all the orders. However, his character must first listen to a gardener with a better plan. The gardener explains how a dry garden can receive water from a nearby stream. When Sam speaks more calmly, the scene becomes easier for everyone to follow. We keep this version because the ruler learns to value another person's ideas.

parallelText.en: Our class rehearses a play about an emperor who rules an imaginary country.
parallelText.zh: 我们班排演一部关于统治虚构国家的皇帝的戏。

parallelText.en: Sam wants to wear the paper crown and give all the orders.
parallelText.zh: 萨姆想戴纸王冠，发出所有命令。

parallelText.en: However, his character must first listen to a gardener with a better plan.
parallelText.zh: 然而，他扮演的人物必须先听取一位有更好计划的园丁的意见。

parallelText.en: The gardener explains how a dry garden can receive water from a nearby stream.
parallelText.zh: 园丁解释如何从附近溪流给干旱的花园引水。

parallelText.en: When Sam speaks more calmly, the scene becomes easier for everyone to follow.
parallelText.zh: 萨姆说得更平和后，大家更容易看懂这一幕。

parallelText.en: We keep this version because the ruler learns to value another person's ideas.
parallelText.zh: 我们保留了这个版本，因为统治者学会了重视别人的想法。

passages.text: The reading club wants a place to share short reviews of favourite books. Lena builds a simple website with three pages: books, reviews and questions. At first, she copies a sentence from a book because she cannot think of an opening. Her partner asks what she herself likes about the story. Lena writes her own review about the brave girl and the surprising ending. They test every page on the classroom computer before showing it to the club. Lena is pleased that visitors can read ideas that truly belong to her.

parallelText.en: The reading club wants a place to share short reviews of favourite books.
parallelText.zh: 阅读社团想找个地方分享喜欢的书的简短书评。

parallelText.en: Lena builds a simple website with three pages: books, reviews and questions.

parallelText.en: At first, she copies a sentence from a book because she cannot think of an opening.
parallelText.zh: 起初，她想不出开头，就从书里抄了一个句子。

parallelText.en: Her partner asks what she herself likes about the story.
parallelText.zh: 同伴问她自己喜欢故事的什么。

parallelText.en: Lena writes her own review about the brave girl and the surprising ending.
parallelText.zh: 莉娜写出自己的书评，谈论勇敢的女孩和意外的结局。

parallelText.en: They test every page on the classroom computer before showing it to the club.
parallelText.zh: 展示给社团前，他们在教室电脑上检查每个页面。

parallelText.en: Lena is pleased that visitors can read ideas that truly belong to her.
parallelText.zh: 莉娜很高兴，访客可以读到真正属于她的想法。
